name: tract_id
description: Foreign key to census_tracts.tract_id; source: Census TIGER/Line

name: nta_code
description: 2020 NYC Neighborhood Tabulation Area code; source: NYC DCP 2020 Census Tracts to 2020 NTAs and CDTAs Equivalency (NYC Open Data hm78-6dwm)

name: nta_name
description: Human-readable NTA name (e.g. Jamaica); source: NYC Open Data hm78-6dwm

name: overlap_pct
description: Share of the tract assigned to this NTA; always 1.0 because 2020 tracts nest in 2020 NTAs; kept as the weight for NTA-level aggregation; derived in src/tract_nta.py
